decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is closely related to the firm's maritime customer base and existing engineering know-how, so its absorptive capacity to refine and support this niche line is high despite the market being specialized.

A medical examination light is more adjacent than core to the firm's established business, but its professional lighting expertise, testing capabilities and institutional customer access give it enough capacity to learn and improve rather than exit quickly.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit very strongly with the firm's industrial focus, safety-oriented engineering competences and certified manufacturing, making this a highly compatible product line to retain and develop.

The designer task light is somewhat less central than industrial and maritime lines, but as a relaunch of a previously popular product it builds on prior market knowledge and can be sustained with limited additional learning costs.
